description: Transform your risk management with the Premium Risk Heatmap for Power BI. This advanced visual provides a sleek, modern way to visualize Impact vs. Likelihood using a dynamic matrix. Key Features: Risk Movement Tracking: Visualize how risks evolve over time with smooth trajectories and breadcrumbs. Smart Clustering: Automatically group multiple risks in the same zone to maintain a clean, readable dashboard. Premium Aesthetics: Features a modern Glassmorphism design with customizable blur, transparency, and high-quality D3 animations. Fully Customizable: Adjust grid size (rows/columns), colors, fonts, and indicator sizes to match your corporate branding. Enterprise Ready: Fully localized and optimized for performance with large datasets.
